ai_typeOfModel: Dense architecture (31B Dense) with hybrid attention interleaving local sliding window attention and full global attention; the Gemma 4 family includes Dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants
ai_domain: Multilingual support in over 140 languages; out-of-the-box support for 35+ languages, pre-trained on 140+ languages
@graph.ai_informationAboutApplication:
Intended uses: Content creation and communication (text generation, chatbots and conversational AI, text summarization, image data extraction, audio processing and interaction for E2B/E4B/12B) and research and education (NLP and VLM research, language learning tools, knowledge exploration).
Target systems: Chatbots/conversational AI (customer service, virtual assistants, interactive applications), and agentic workflows/autonomous agents via native function calling; also research foundation for VLM/NLP
@graph.ai_limitation: Limitations include training data biases/gaps affecting responses; difficulty with open-ended or highly complex tasks; struggles with subtle nuances, sarcasm, figurative language; may generate incorrect or outdated factual statements; may lack common sense reasoning. Risks include generation of harmful content, misuse, privacy violations and perpetuation of biases.

ai_standardCompliance: Safety evaluations align with Google's AI principles and Google's safety policies. The card names no external standards or regulations such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the EU AI Act.

@graph.comment:
releaseTime: release date not stated in the card; Hugging Face repo creation time used.
access_conditions: false
additional_assets: The card links to a Hugging Face collection of Gemma 4 models, a GitHub organization (google-gemma), documentation, and a technical report on arXiv. It states that the release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants (base model google/gemma-4-31B). No training data or training code is stated as released.
architecture_details: 31B Dense model: 30.7B parameters, 60 layers, 1024-token sliding window, 256K context, 262K vocabulary. Hybrid attention interleaves local sliding window attention with full global attention (final layer always global), giving the speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing deep awareness for complex, long-context tasks. Global layers use unified Keys and Values and Proportional RoPE (p-RoPE) to optimize memory for long contexts.
design_rationale: The card gives rationales for some design choices. Hybrid attention (local sliding window interleaved with global) gives the speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without losing deep awareness for long-context tasks. Training data includes code to learn programming syntax and patterns, and mathematical text to learn logical reasoning, symbolic representation and to address mathematical queries.
integration_means: Usable with the Hugging Face Transformers library (pip install -U transformers torch accelerate; load via AutoProcessor and AutoModelForMultimodalLM). Chat format uses system, assistant and user roles; thinking is enabled with the <|think|> token at the start of the system prompt.
base_model_relation: finetune
